floorPlan.heading: Floor plan

designWorkspace.renderCompleteFallback: Render complete — the real result should appear on the next check.

homeDashboard.heroDescription: Niwasthan connects your real home to design, materials, budget, and execution—so you can see the important decisions before they become expensive ones.

homeDashboard.step1Description: Start with the real property, priorities, and budget you want to stay honest about.
homeDashboard.step2Description: Upload a floor plan so rooms, dimensions, and unknowns can be reviewed before design decisions.
homeDashboard.step3Description: Compare strong design directions grounded in your home—not a generic room.
homeDashboard.step4Description: See materials, budget impact, and execution choices before you commit.
homeDashboard.bringHomeIntoRoomTitle: Bring the real home into the room.

homeDashboard.beautifulOptionTitle: A beautiful option should explain its consequences.

intelligenceWorkspace.noIntelligenceRecordYet: No home intelligence record is available yet.

intelligenceWorkspace.immersiveDescription: The future-home scene becomes available only when the plan and provider support it.
intelligenceWorkspace.whatIfDescription: Run a potential change against a budget version. A preview is not an accepted or realised saving.

propertyMemory.heading: A home should remember what matters to you.
propertyMemory.description: This memory guides recommendations across rooms and projects. It is a user-owned preference record, not a claim about the physical home.
propertyMemory.emptyHeading: Home Memory is not recorded yet.
propertyMemory.emptyDescription: Niwasthan will not infer a lifestyle preference from a generated image or a click. Add it through the guided home-intelligence flow when you are ready.
